svg.title: Breadboard wiring for the MSP2807 screen and the YD-ESP32-S3
svg.desc: The ESP32 header sits in column d and the screen header in column g. CS, RESET, DC, MOSI, SCK and LED are straight jumpers from column e to column f on strips 4 to 9. T_CLK, T_CS, T_DIN and T_DO are straight jumpers on strips 11 to 14. MISO and T_IRQ are not connected. VCC runs from e21 along the centre gap to f2. GND runs from e1 to f1, then h1 to h3 under the screen.
